quality_guards: Violence controls depend on work activity, client or public interaction, lone working, time, location, cash or valuables, worker vulnerability and incident history.
Workplace-violence evidence is activity-, worker- and context-specific and is not an exact parcel-level assault probability.
Stress controls depend on work design, workload, autonomy, support, relationships, organisational change, worker needs and existing health conditions.
Work-related-stress evidence is organisation-, role- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level mental-health probability.
Agricultural controls depend on machine type, terrain, maintenance, livestock behaviour, public access, worker competence, weather and the specific operation.
Agricultural evidence is activity-, equipment-, animal- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Tree-work controls depend on species, tree condition, terrain, weather, public access, equipment, work position, escape routes and worker competence.
Tree-work evidence is tree-, task-, equipment- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level struck-by or fall probability.
Crowd controls depend on audience profile, attendance, venue capacity, event activity, weather, transport, behaviour and emergency arrangements.
Crowd-safety evidence is event-, audience-, venue- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level crushing or disorder probability.
Emergency arrangements depend on event scale, activities, crowd profile, weather, temporary structures, medical needs and local responder capability.
Event-emergency evidence is event-, venue- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level emergency-impact probability.
Fairground controls depend on device design, maturity, inspection, maintenance, setup, weather, rider characteristics, operator competence and emergency capability.
Fairground evidence is device-, operator-, site- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level ride-injury probability.
Pool controls depend on pool type, users, activities, supervision, water treatment, plant, outlets, occupancy and emergency response.
Swimming-pool evidence is facility-, activity- and operating-condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level drowning or illness probability.
School controls depend on age groups, curriculum activities, premises, equipment, pupils' needs, visitors, contractors and local management arrangements.
Education evidence is premises-, activity-, pupil- and management-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
DSEAR controls depend on substance properties, quantity, process, ventilation, containment, ignition sources, zoning and emergency arrangements.
DSEAR evidence is substance-, process-, workplace- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire or explosion probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
